en.title: DAA 4.4(2) in Part 4 (money services / stablecoin issuers) addresses 'a Digital Asset Trading Facility Operator'
en.summary: 4.4(2) - the only Board-of-Directors rule in Part 4 - repeats verbatim 2.3.2(1) for a 'Digital Asset Trading Facility Operator', which is regulated by Chapter 2. 4.4(1), (3) and (4) address the Digital Asset Service Provider. Amendments No. 4 edited this very subrule (deleting the one-third independence sentence and its note) and left the addressee unchanged.
en.correction: Please replace "Digital Asset Trading Facility Operator" (twice) with "Digital Asset Service Provider" in 4.4(2), as in 4.4(1), (3) and (4).

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.locator: DAA V5, 4.4(2) (identical sentence also at 2.3.2(1), p.12)
quotes.text: A Digital Asset Trading Facility Operator must have an effective Board of Directors which is collectively accountable for ensuring that the Digital Asset Trading Facility Operator’s business is managed prudently and soundly.

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.text: Members of the Governing Body of the Digital Asset Service Provider must have sufficiently good repute
